# Components

## AI Guard

* :sparkles: Support `DD_APM_TRACING_ENABLED=false` for AI Guard traces (#11885 - @claponcet)

## Application Security Management (WAF)

* :sparkles: Update default AppSec ruleset to release 1.18.2 (#12099 - @jandro996)
* :bug: Stamp `_dd.apm.enabled` on every exported chunk when APM tracing is disabled (#12028 - @claponcet)
* :bug: Fix WafContext TOCTOU race resurrecting orphaned native contexts (#12024 - @jandro996)
* :bug: Fix Metaspace leak in SCA Reachability retransform and opcode injection (#12013 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: Report agentic onboarding marker in configuration telemetry (RFC-1113) (#11983 - @christophe-papazian)
* :bug: Bound multipart text/plain field materialization in Jersey AppSec (#11944 - @jandro996)
* :bug: Update `libddwaf-java` to 17.4.0 (#11943 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: AppSec Lambda: Analyze HTTP response (#11750 - @claponcet)
* :sparkles: Add `server.request.body.files_content` AppSec address for Undertow and Play (#11726 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: Add `server.request.body.files_content` AppSec address for Akka HTTP (#11725 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: Add `server.request.body.files_content` AppSec address for Vert.x 3/4/5 (#11724 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: Add `server.request.body.files_content` AppSec address for Jetty (#11706 - @jandro996)

## Build & Tooling

* :sparkles: Update JMXFetch to 0.52.1 (#12121 - @sarahchen6)

## Continuous Integration Visibility

* :bug: Restore JUnit4 test ordering on Gradle 9.3+ (#12098 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Add `ci.pipeline.display_name` tag for Buildkite pipelines (#12079 - @gbrandrea)
* :sparkles: Allow Gradle verification of Test Optimization dependencies (#12077 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Improve codeowners lookup performance (#12058 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :bug: Fix GitLab codeowners exclusion handling (#12021 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :bug: Stop retrying aborted Karate scenarios (#12015 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :bug: Finish Karate tests after scenario post-processing (#12014 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :bug: Avoid retrying untracked Karate scenarios (#12012 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Improve GitLab codeowners parsing (#11999 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Add code coverage report flags (#11981 - @juan-fernandez)
* :sparkles: Memoize per-test class analysis in a module-wide cache (#11969 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Add test reporting for Karate v2 (#11923 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Avoid error logging when parsing optional sections in codeowners file (#11881 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Add AGP usage visibility for Gradle projects (#11869 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Add Android/Robolectric visibility to Test Optimization spans (#11852 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Avoid final field modifications in Cucumber and Spock instrumentations (#11851 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :bug: Fix Cucumber test retries running under Suite (#11850 - @daniel-mohedano)
* :sparkles: Avoid final field modification in JUnit5 instrumentation (#11752 - @daniel-mohedano)

## Data Streams Monitoring

* :broom: Remove full schema collection from Kafka, Avro, and Protobuf instrumentation (#12038 - @piochelepiotr)
* :bug: Tag consumer spans with the pathway hash on every data streams checkpoint (#11808 - @ericfirth)

## Dynamic Instrumentation

* :bug: Avoid calling synchronized wrappers when capturing (#12106 - @tylfin)
* :bug: Fix initialization of samplers for probe file (#12067 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Update record detection for fixed JDK (#12031 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Update MethodParameters detection for fixed JDK (#12025 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix NullPointerException in Exception Replay (#11976 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Avoid false warning when no stacktrace (#11971 - @jpbempel)
* :sparkles: Hoist local vars for exception probes (#11964 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix instrumenting metric probes for Kotlin (#11890 - @jpbempel)

## ML Observability (LLMObs)

* :sparkles: Add LLMObs Tool Definitions API (#12072 - @sabrenner)

## Metrics

* :sparkles: Emit additional metric tags on the OTLP stats export path (client-side stats) (#12069 - @dougqh)
* :sparkles: Add span-derived primary tags (CSS v1.3.0) (#11402 - @dougqh)

## OpenFeature

* :sparkles: Add agentless Feature Flagging configuration source (#11892 - @leoromanovsky)
* :sparkles: Add experimental, gated feature-flag span enrichment (#11658 - @leoromanovsky)

## Platform

* :sparkles: Improve JSON component (#12086 - @PerfectSlayer)

## Profiling

* :bug: Update java-profiler (ddprof) to 1.48.1 (#12133 - @kaahos)
	* Gracefully disable the profiler instead of crashing when `libgcc_s.so.1` is unavailable by @zhengyu123 in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/689
	* Avoid retaining invalid HotSpot VM method pointers during stack walking and JFR serialization by @jbachorik in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/699
* :bug: Update java-profiler (ddprof) to 1.48.0 (#12076 - @kaahos)
	* Add native malloc/socket stack capture with profiler-hook frame skipping by @jbachorik in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/648
	* Add categorized native-memory accounting by @rkennke in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/669
	* Set up signal handlers before initializing VMStructs and protect `VMFlag::name()` calls by @zhengyu123 in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/674
	* Make CodeCache `memoryUsage()` accurate and live by @rkennke in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/677
	* Report the actual runtime-stubs cache size by @rkennke in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/681
	* Use `sigsetjmp`/`siglongjmp` instead of `setjmp`/`longjmp` by @zhengyu123 in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/686
* :bug: Update java-profiler (ddprof) to 1.47.0 (#12076 - @rkennke)
	* Add all-native OTEL context write API — Phase 1 (PROF-15271) by @rkennke in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/631
	* Guard line-number-table copy against stale jmethodID by @jbachorik in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/647
	* Prevent duplicate trace_id after CallTraceHashTable expansion by @jbachorik in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/659
	* Fix native OOM from unbounded CallTraceHashTable expansion by @jbachorik in https://github.com/DataDog/java-profiler/pull/670
* :closed_lock_with_key: Address CVE-2026-59949 by upgrading LZ4 to v1.11.1 (#12091 - @vandonr)
* :bug: Migrate context bridge to the all-native DDProf API (Phase 2) (#11899 - @rkennke)

## Testing

* :sparkles: Add APM test agent trace decoding (#12089 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :sparkles: Add decoded span assert rules (#12088 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :sparkles: Avoid null collection on decoded spans (#12087 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :sparkles: Add test agent session token support (#12050 - @PerfectSlayer)

## Trace context propagation

* :bug: Decouple W3C lastParentId from shared propagation-tag mutation (#11702 - @dougqh)

## Tracer core

* :sparkles: Fix propagation tag serialization for trace chunks (#12096 - @sarahchen6)
* :sparkles: Report OTLP export status in tracer startup log (#12062 - @bm1549)
* :bug: Fix lookup-then-read race in GenerationalUtf8Cache.getUtf8 (#11917 - @dougqh)
* :sparkles: Wire per-component cardinality limits from Config (#11732 - @dougqh)

## Tracer internal logging

* :bulb: Enable secure random ID generation for AWS Lambda MicroVM environments (#11622 - @litianningdatadog)

# Instrumentations

## Apache Spark instrumentation

* :sparkles: Add Spark 4.0.0 test suite on JDK 17 to spark_2.13 (#12049 - @aboitreaud)
* :sparkles: Mix Databricks repair attempt into Spark parent trace id (#12022 - @aboitreaud)

## Core Java language instrumentation

* :zap::broom: Replace ThreadPoolExecutor context-store with ClassValue cache (#12105 - @mcculls)

## Kafka instrumentation

* :broom: Remove full schema collection from Kafka, Avro, and Protobuf instrumentation (#12038 - @piochelepiotr)
* :bug: Fix NoSuchElementException from unchecked `Optional.get()` in Kafka consumer instrumentation (#12007 - @piochelepiotr)

## Netty instrumentation

* :bug: Keep Netty 4.1 server spans open until streaming responses complete (#11941 - @ygree)
* :bug: Fix Netty 4.1 tracing for pipelined HTTP/1.1 responses (#11937 - @ygree)

## OpenTelemetry instrumentation

* :sparkles: Telemetry for OTLP traces/metrics/logs (#12057 - @mcculls)
* :sparkles::zap: Limit growth of OTLP trace buffer (#12052 - @mcculls)
* :sparkles: Support OTLP export over "http/json" for traces, metrics, and logs (#12018 - @mcculls)

## Protocol Buffer instrumentation

* :broom: Remove full schema collection from Kafka, Avro, and Protobuf instrumentation (#12038 - @piochelepiotr)

## RabbitMQ instrumentation

* :bug: Use routing key as DSM topic for RabbitMQ default-exchange publishes (#11805 - @ericfirth)

## Reactor instrumentation

* :sparkles: Support W3C baggage propagation across reactor-netty connect hand-off (#12027 - @mcculls)
* :bug: Fix multicast context propagation race in reactor/reactive-streams (#11825 - @amarziali)

## Spring instrumentation

* :bug: Tag `@Async` and `@Scheduled` spring-scheduling spans as errored on exception (#12071 - @ValentinZakharov)

## All other instrumentations

* :sparkles: Support W3C baggage propagation across various async instrumentation (#12033 - @mcculls)
* :bug: Add missing throwable suppression on instrumentation advice (#12019 - @PerfectSlayer)
* :bug: Fix Undertow versions > 2.2.40, 2.3.25 and 2.4.0 (#11844 - @vandonr)
